text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while training with Biwa 
Hayahide...

Please let me collect your training data! 
Come on, lend me a hand!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: No, I'm a bit busy right now... I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What in the world... is that doing?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you guys are...! Sorry to bother you, 
but would you mind hearing me out?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She, Dr. Sugarlights, is a scientist 
collaborating with Tracen Academy. This 
might be about an important project—"
choice_data_list:
Sure, if you don't mind having us, we'd be 
glad to visit.

Sure, if you don't mind having us, we'd be 
glad to visit.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Right now, I'm developing a 
machine that assists with safe training, 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
That machine's features include 
visualizing exercise intensity, suggesting 
optimal training phases, and even 
automatically calculating injury risk!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"That is the 'U-TAS', the dream machine 
designed to support Umamusume training!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What a remarkably Umamusume-centric design 
philosophy...! If realized, it will change 
the very future of Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
However, we lack sufficient training data 
to feed into "U-TAS"... so development has 
stalled.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In that case, please let me help. I will 
provide you with any data you need.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, we should definitely move forward 
with this project!

Yeah, we should definitely push forward 
with this project!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure!? This is practically 
volunteer work, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind. It can change the future of 
Umamusume, can it not?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Warding off injuries that would plunge one 
into despair—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“—That is more than enough. No one should 
ever have to go through that again.”

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I see... In that case, I'll gladly accept 
your offer. This will really speed up 
development!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Since we have the chance, let's 
gather data efficiently and give our 
development speed a boost.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-kun, I have a request. I would 
like your permission to publish all of my 
data to the public without holding 
anything back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide is sharp at times like this. 
Putting my faith in her words, I decided 
to accept...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, Biwa Hayahide invited many 
students and held an information session 
for "U-TAS."
choice_data_list:
Quite a crowd has gathered... Alright, 
let's begin!

So many people showed up... Alright, let's 
get started!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, everyone! I am currently 
involved in developing a training machine 
called 'U-TAS'. I would love for you all 
to lend your cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Specifically, I'd like you to provide me 
with your training data.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As your reward—my data, forged through 
hard work and fierce rivalry alongside all 
my comrades-in-arms! I shall share every 
last bit of it with you all!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: !? Ooooohh!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It includes high-load training data 
designed with GⅠ races in mind. Its 
utility should go without saying!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that super risky? It kind of feels 
like there's a catch...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Even if they consult "past" data, I 
have no intention of losing. ...And 
besides, this is not a gamble.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It's an 'investment' to foster your 
growth while bringing the dream machine 
known as 'U-TAS' to completion!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now, this is our chance! Our chance to 
"create the future"!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"‘...I'll help! Count me in!’ ‘Hey, no 
fair cutting in line! Me too!’"
choice_data_list:
Amazing...! This will cut down development 
time!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Nicely done, Trainer-kun! We've taken a 
step toward a future where fewer Umamusume 
weep over injuries!
choice_data_list: Yeah, things are gonna get busy from here.

Yeah, things are going to get busy from 
here on out.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's get moving too. We need to collect 
successful training data for 'U-TAS'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The key to developing the "U-TAS" lies in 
the number of training successes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While being careful not to fail, let's 
gather plenty of success data with Biwa 
Hayahide!
